scientific_integrity: The counting recurrences process all 2^21 subsets without pruning; independent reverse and forward implementations, full-plane checks, and a direct maximum-length witness are supplied. 2014 legal-covering formalism and the 2016 hypergraph–total-domination identity are cited as prior work, not originality claims.
scientific_limitations: An exhaustive finite result only for the Desarguesian plane of order four; no formula for other field orders or non-Desarguesian geometries. Profile types are line-intersection signatures, not automorphism orbits. Priority remains subject to unindexed or inaccessible literature; independent scientific validation has not been performed.
title: Six line-intersection profiles of longest total-dominating sequences in \(\operatorname{PG}(2,4)\)
